the letter (same page, same hand, same hook); "in the words that you left"; it tears into fragments

"every war": the point is a candle; a hand-drawn room after a war, a helmet, the letter with the hook
"every lullaby": a cradle rocking by lamplight
"every last goodbye": hands part at a train door; a spark stays
KV1 again: the sky falls away; the three memories rise as constellations; they look up

"heat": hands around a bowl, steam, a frosted window
"hearts": a newborn on a chest, two layers in depth; the fist flexes on the two hits
B3: B, eyes closed, as if listening to a heartbeat
"silent, still": the town folds back into the page (36.85), then the village (37.54); only the hill
"the first fire": a hand strikes stone on stone; it catches on the 40.50 hit
"on the first cold hill": one fire on the crest
